quest.title: Silently the Butterfly Crosses the Valley
quest.description: Yaodie Valley seems to conceal secrets unknown to all...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Notes
dialogues.text: (The content is blurry and only a few incomplete sentences written in elegant handwriting are legible...)

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Notes
dialogues.text: "As the vivid butterflies converge in the jar, the adeptal energy surges anew, akin to new life restored to a withered tree..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Notes
dialogues.text: "Go west and behold <color=#00E1FFFF>Lingshu Courtyard</color>, and..."

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Sorry? What were you saying just now...?

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Uh... Huh? Who art thou who disturb my beauty sleep...!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!? Wh—Who's that?

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Agh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Hahahahaha! Yes, yes! To fear me is only natural! Were I unconfined to this stone, you would already be in mine belly!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What...? Ah! So you're just a talking stone statue... Paimon thought you were a monster of some sort!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Hmph! What dost thou mean, "just a talking stone statue"!? Would not one such be frightening in itself?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, we've come across many statues like you before, is the thing...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Wh—What!? *sigh* Fine. Seems like there's no scaring you guys...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why must you do that, anyway? Sheesh! You're just a stone statue!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Hmph! Even if I was "just a stone statue," this place is still the Herblord's abode! When she was yet with us, she did not appreciate others disturbing her peace at their liberty!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: And that's why I scare all the pesky ones away! I shall continue to do so even if she isn't around anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, your presence does feel somewhat different from that of those ordinary mortals, and considering that I couldn't scare you either...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: May I please ask you for a favor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What can we help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Ahem. Take a look at these colorful butterflies! Ever since the abode's lord departed, these little things have scattered all over the place, flying about as they please...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shh... Hang on, there's one on your head! Just a moment. We'll help you get it...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Phew... Yes, just like that!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: The abode's Herblord previously used these colorful butterflies to adorn its door, but said mechanism was later destroyed. These colorful butterflies and the medicine jar... were originally meant to nourish the adeptal tree.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Adeptal tree?

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Heh, that's right! Back then, the Herblord planted this adeptal tree herself...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: It may be withered now, but the Herblord said that so long as the colorful butterflies haven't all dispersed, the tree can be revived!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: *sigh* She departed as soon as she lost the power to maintain her human form. I wonder how she's doing these days...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "As the vivid butterflies converge in the jar, new life shall be restored to the withered tree..."

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Yep, that's right! As long as... Wait, how did you know?

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Never mind. Anyway, that's about it! As long as those colorful butterflies get put back into the jar, we can then nourish that withered tree! I'm counting on you, kind humans!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Phew... Yep, just like that!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: The abode's Herblord previously used these colorful butterflies to adorn its door, but that mechanism was later destroyed. These colorful butterflies and the medicine jar were originally meant to nourish the adeptal tree.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Adeptal tree?

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Heh, that's right! Back then, the Herblord planted this adeptal tree herself...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: It may be withered now, but the Herblord said that so long as the colorful butterflies haven't all dispersed, the tree can be revived!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: *sigh* She departed as soon as she lost the power to maintain her human form. I wonder how she's doing these days...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what am I supposed to do?

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Ah, my apologies. I got a little carried away reminiscing about my lord...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Ahem! Listen carefully, humans! As long as those colorful butterflies get put back into the jar, we can then nourish the withered tree!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Heh, this is the adeptal mechanism designed by the Herblord. Pretty amazing, huh?

choices.text: Let me give it a try.

response.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
response.text: Sure thing. I'm counting on you then, kind humans!

response.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
response.text: Eh? Yeah, why is that... Perhaps the Herblord was just really into colorful butterflies?

response.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
response.text: Uh... Anyway, I'm counting on you to get them back into the jar, kind humans!

talks.objective: Chase the butterflies into the medicine jar

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Hmm...? Who art thou, to disturb mine... Ah, it's you, kind humans.

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Butterflies... Can you not find them? Hm... Perhaps, if you look over there...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: So if that's all, I'm rather sleepy right now, so... *yawn* Don't mind me for a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Zzz... Zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You liar! We've already returned all the colorful butterflies to the jar, but the adeptal tree still looks the same to Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Hmm...? Who art thou, to disturb mine... Ah, it's you, kind humans.

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Ooh! I never thought you'd actually be able to find all the colorful butterflies! I just said that on a whim...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: No, I meant... I felt the adeptal energies too! We just need to recite the formula that Herblord left us and we can revive the adeptal tree!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Hold on, how did that chant go again...?

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: "...Born in winter, thriving and withering through time. But I yearn for spring when beauty is regained..."

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Butterflies flutter... flutter... Uh, I don't remember what comes next, but it ends with all being revived!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's changed completely!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Since the Herblord entrusted the tree to me, I couldn't stand to see it continue to wither! Thank you, kind humans!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You couldn't even remember the phrase at all!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Eh, don't sweat the small stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Oh, if you're interested, I can give you a secret tip! Break off a branch and put it in the broken jar outside the abode, and the stone gate will open...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Hmm...? Who art thou, to disturb mine... Ah, it's you, kind humans.

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: I leave the matter of the butterflies to you. I'm rather sleepy right now, so... *yawn* Don't mind me for a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Zzz... Zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Carefree Simulacrum
dialogues.text: Zzz... Come now, pipe down, don't be so noisy...

talks.objective: Look for the medicine jar mentioned by the Sacred Simulacrum

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Text (I)
dialogues.text: "...They say fish have a bad memory, and I'm starting to wonder if she is one. She won't stop telling me about that 'Motive Mainjade' business..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Text (I)
dialogues.text: "...Even though it always fills me with the urge to interrupt her, seeing that look of joy on her face makes me decide against it... If anything, efficiency takes a hit when she isn't here to natter away..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Text (I)
dialogues.text: "...I must keep this locked up. I can never let any person or fish see this. She might start jumping for joy otherwise..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we take a look around? This is the abode of an adeptus, after all, so there might be some kinda arcane array that'll let us cross vast distances in a jiffy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course, if you wanna walk, that's fine too!
